note: Every fandom owns its own gallery. Images dominate; video and audio are kept to one or two per fandom so the wall still reads as artwork. `shape` drives the mosaic layout, `cutout` marks transparent character plates that need a mat instead of a photo frame, and `cover` promotes the first tile to a double-width feature plate.
